appDesc.message: Switch this device between Keenetic router access policies in one click.

errNoChallenge.message: The router did not send an authentication challenge

errNoChallengeDetail.message: This address appears to serve something other than the KeeneticOS web interface.

errPasswordNotSet.message: The router password is not set

errSessionNotStored.message: The router accepted the password, but the session was not stored

errSessionNotStoredDetail.message: The browser is not sending the router's session cookie. Check that permission for the router address is granted in the extension settings.

errAuthRejected.message: The router rejected the username and password

errAuthRejectedDetail.message: If the credentials are definitely correct, close the router web interface tab: it refreshes the session and stops the extension from signing in.

errForbiddenDetail.message: KeeneticOS only accepts requests to /rci/ that carry its own Origin. The extension rewrites the header with a declarativeNetRequest rule — check that permission for the router address is granted in chrome://extensions and reload the extension.

errRciHttp.message: Request to the router failed: HTTP $status$

errBadResponse.message: Unexpected response format from the router

errWhoamiFailed.message: The router could not identify this device

errNoDeviceSelected.message: No device is selected in the settings

errPolicyNotApplied.message: The router did not apply the new policy

errPolicyNotAppliedDetail.message: Expected "$expected$", but after the write the router reports "$actual$".

errOriginRule.message: Could not install the Origin rewrite rule: $reason$

errNoBackgroundResponse.message: The extension background script did not respond

errBaseUrlNotSet.message: The router address is not set

errNoPermission.message: No access to the router address

errNoPermissionDetail.message: Open the extension settings and grant permission for $url$.

policyNoneSub.message: shared access, same as other devices

noPolicies.message: No access policies are configured on the router — create one in the Keenetic web interface.

deviceBlocked.message: This device is denied internet access in the router settings.

optionsIntro.message: Two steps: connect to the router, then say which device to switch.

sectionRouterSub.message: Sign-in details for the Keenetic web interface.

fieldBaseUrlHint.message: The same address you use to open the Keenetic panel.

passwordWarnBody.message: The password is stored unencrypted in your Chrome profile. Choose this only on your own trusted computer.

sectionDeviceSub.message: This is the device whose policy will be switched.

modeAutoHint.message: The router reports the MAC address the request came from (RCI whoami). Works as long as the browser reaches the router directly.

modeManualHint.message: Needed when auto-detection returns the wrong MAC address (VPN, bridges, docking stations).

deviceListPlaceholder.message: — the list loads after you test the connection —

deviceHintNeedTest.message: Press "Test connection" to load devices from the router.

permNotGranted.message: Access to $url$ is not granted yet — press "Test connection".

permDenied.message: Without access to the router address the extension cannot work.

needDevice.message: Pick a device or turn on auto-detection.

demoSub.message: KeenSwitch runs on a sample local network without connecting to a router.

demoNote.message: Open KeenSwitch from the Chrome toolbar to pick test devices and switch their policies. All data is fictional and stays in your browser.

demoEntrySub.message: Take a look at the interface using safe test data.

startDemo.message: Start the demo without a router

fieldPasswordHint.message: The password is used only to sign in to your router.

passwordSessionHint.message: Safer. The password is deleted when the browser closes.

passwordLocalHint.message: The password will be filled in after a browser restart.

noActiveDevices.message: The router does not see any active devices.

testDevicesNoWhoami.message: Devices: $count$. Auto-detection did not work — pick the device manually.

testOkSession.message: Connected through an already active router session. The username and password you entered were not verified. $summary$

errRouterTimeout.message: The router did not respond in time

errRouterTimeoutDetail.message: Waited $seconds$s for a reply. Check the router address and your connection to its network.
